hero.headline: Two injured in U.S. 1 tractor-trailer crash in Hobe Sound; one flown to hospital
hero.teaser:
Two people were injured Monday in a crash involving a vehicle and a tractor-trailer at U.S. 1 and SE Hobe Terrace in Hobe Sound, according to the Martin County Sheriff’s Office.

O
hero.body:
Two people were injured Monday in a crash involving a vehicle and a tractor-trailer at U.S. 1 and SE Hobe Terrace in Hobe Sound, according to the Martin County Sheriff’s Office.

 One person suffered life-threatening injuries and was flown to St. Mary’s Medical Center by Martin County Fire Rescue’s LifeStar, the Sheriff’s Office said. A second person was also injured in the crash.

 The Martin County Sheriff’s Office and Florida Highway Patrol are investigating the crash, which the Sheriff’s Office described as a serious injury crash.

cards.headline: Flood watch issued for Wednesday as Treasure Coast rain chances increase
cards.teaser: A flood watch has been issued for Wednesday, when rain chances on the Treasure Coast are forecast to reach their highest level of the week. Scattered to numerous showers and isolat
cards.body:
A flood watch has been issued for Wednesday, when rain chances on the Treasure Coast are forecast to reach their highest level of the week. Scattered to numerous showers and isolated thunderstorms are possible.

 Rain chances are expected to increase slightly Tuesday, with warmer temperatures on the way. The early-week forecast called for a mix of sun and clouds, highs in the mid to upper 70s and light northwest winds.

 Partly cloudy skies and light northwest winds were forecast overnight, with lows in the low 60s along the Treasure Coast and in Okeechobee County. Palm Beach County’s overnight lows were forecast in the low to mid 60s.
